J.'''" '''Edgecombe Jr.''' (born July 30, 2005) is a Bahamian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor Bears]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class. Edgecombe was selected with the third overall pick by the 76ers in the [[2025 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |last=Carlin |first=Ky |date=June 25, 2025 |title=Philadelphia 76ers NBA Draft live updates: Pick results, trade rumors |url=https://sixerswire.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/sixers/2025/06/25/philadelphia-76ers-nba-draft-live-updates-pick-results-trade-rumors/84361626007/ |access-date=June 26, 2025 |website=Sixers Wire|publisher=USA Today |language=en-US}}. He is nicknamed '''"The Generator"''', inspired by his childhood in the Bahamas, where his family relied on a generator for electricity, and by his energetic style of play.{{Cite web |title=VJ Edgecombe: From a Generator to "The Generator" |url=https://greaterthanthegame.org/vj-edgecombe-from-a-generator-to-the-generator/ |access-date=July 4, 2026 |website=Greater Than The Game}} ==Early life and high school career== Edgecombe was born and spent his childhood in [[Bimini]], [[The Bahamas]].{{cite web|url=https://nypost.com/2023/11/10/sports/st-johns-hosting-five-star-prospect-vj-edgecombe/|title=Meet VJ Edgecombe, the five-star prospect St. John's is in the hunt for|first=Zach|last=Braziller|work=[[New York Post]]|date=November 10, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{cite web |last=Adderley |first=Taige |title=Edgecombe Selected to McDonald’s All American Game |url=https://ournews.bs/edgecombe-selected-to-mcdonalds-all-american-game/ |website=Our News |access-date=January 26, 2024 |date=January 24, 2024}} Edgecombe grew up in the Abaco Islands of The Bahamas, where he first played basketball in local youth leagues. He participated in development camps organized by NBA player [[Buddy Hield]], whom he later described as a mentor figure.{{cite web |title=Supporting Bahamas Basketball: VJ Edgecombe takes the torch |url=https://andscape.com/features/philadelphia-76ers-guard-vj-edgecombe-takes-torch-for-bahamas-basketball/ |website=Andscape |publisher=ESPN |date=July 10, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025|last=Spears|first=Marc J.}} Edgecombe described himself as "[coming] from nothing", living off a generator due to limited electricity.{{cite web|url=https://www.nbcsportsphiladelphia.com/nba/philadelphia-76ers/sixers-draft-vj-edgecombe-2025-nba-draft-news/672234/|title=Sixers take VJ Edgecombe at No. 3 in draft, add to group of young guards|work=NBC Sports Philadelphia|date=June 25, 2025|last=Levick|first=Noah}}{{cite web|url=https://www.tmz.com/2025/06/26/vj-edgecombe-cries-nba-draft-mom/|title=V.J. Edgecombe Emotional On Draft Night, 'Had No Electricity' Growing Up|work=TMZ|date=June 26, 2025}} He immigrated to the United States when he was in ninth grade, originally settling in Florida.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/article/vj-edgecombes-journey-from-the-bahamas-has-him-poised-as-a-top-5-player-214067797/|title=VJ Edgecombe's journey from The Bahamas has him close to the top of the 2024 ranks|first=Adam|last=Rowe|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=August 10, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}}{{cite web |title=The Bahamas’ Edge: VJ Edgecombe talks about time with the national team |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/news/the-bahamas-edge-vj-edgecombe-talks-about-time-with-the-national-team |website=FIBA |date=August 12, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} : Edgecombe has said that leaving the Bahamas at age fifteen to pursue basketball in the United States was "one of the hardest but best decisions" of his life He attended Victory International Institute in [[West Palm Beach, Florida]] for two years before transferring to [[Long Island Lutheran Middle and High School]] in [[Brookville, New York]] as a boarding student.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/miami/article/5-star-sf-vj-edgecombe-thinks-highly-of-miami-hurricanes-basketb-212507535/|title=5-Star SF VJ Edgecombe thinks highly of Miami|first=Cristopher|last=Stock|website=[[247Sports.com]]|date=July 6, 2023|access-date=November 16, 2023}} He averaged 15.5 points, five rebounds, 2.3 assists and 2.2 steals per game during his junior season as the Crusaders won the state championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/acc/2023/10/20/cooper-flagg-duke-basketball-recruiting-blue-devils/71160836007/|title=Cooper Flagg, other Duke basketball recruits visit Blue web|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/high-school/all-long-island/boys-basketball-first-team-2023-b9enlex6|title=Newsday's All-Long Island boys basketball first team 2023|work=[[Newsday]]|date=April 22, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} Edgecombe was named the New York Gatorade Player of the Year and the National Interscholastic Basketball Conference (NIBC) Player of the Year at the end of the season.{{cite web|url=https://nychoops.rivals.com/news/big-ten-offer-for-luhi-guard|title=Big Ten Offer For LuHi Guard|first=Zach|last=Smart|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=April 6, 2023|access-date=November 15, 2023}} As a senior, Edgecombe averaged 17.3 points, six rebounds, four assists and 2.3 steals per game to lead the Crusaders to a 21–5 record. During his senior year, he was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thenassauguardian.com/sports/edgecombe-freeman-selected-for-mcdonald-s-all-american-game/article_9287f056-bbd4-11ee-b7fb-7b1d40101376.html|title=Edgecombe, Freeman selected for McDonald's All-American game|work=[[The Nassau Guardian]]|date=January 26, 2023|access-date=January 26, 2023}} ===Recruiting=== Edgecombe was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2024 class, according to major recruiting services.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/duke/article/latest-intel-on-five-star-g-vj-edgecombe-as-final-official-visit-nears-219431227/|title=Latest Intel on Five-Star G VJ Edgecombe as final official visit nears|first=Adam|last=Rowe|website=[[247Sports]]|date=November 3, 2023|access-date=November 14, 2023}} He was originally rated 153rd in the composite ranking of ''[[247Sports]]'', but moved up to the top five following his performance in the Adidas 3SSB travel circuit as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/Article/kentucky-basketball-recruiting-john-calipari-vj-edgecombe--221035185/|title=John Calipari, staff visit top-5 prospect VJ Edgecombe|first=Chris|last=Fisher|website=[[247Sports]]|date=November 22, 2023|access-date=November 22, 2023}} On January 14, 2024, Edgecombe committed to playing college basketball for [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]] after considering offers from [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39309952 |title=Baylor men's hoops lands top-five senior V.J. J. Edgecombe Baylor 2025 (cropped).jpg|thumb|150px|Edgecombe at the line to shoot a [[free throw]] for [[2025–26 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]] in 2025]] During his lone season at Baylor, Edgecombe drew consistent praise from head coach [[Scott Drew]] for his intensity and work ethic. Drew called him "one of the most disciplined and mature freshmen we’ve ever had" and credited his defensive mindset as a defining part of the team's identity.{{cite web |title=Making History |url=https://baylorbears.com/news/2025/6/23/mens-basketball-making-history |website=Baylor Athletics |date=June 23, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} According to the ''Baylor Lariat'', Drew nicknamed him "The Edge" in practice and said his humility and self-motivation "set the tone for younger players."{{cite web |title=Ready for war: Star freshman VJ Edgecombe locks in for March Madness |url=https://baylorlariat.com/2025/03/19/ready-for-war-star-freshman-vj-edgecombe-locks-in-for-march-madness/ |website=Baylor Lariat |date=March 19, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} Edgecombe averaged 15 points, 5.4 rebounds, 3.3 assists and 2.1 steals per game while shooting 43.8 percent from the field. He was named [[Big 12]] Freshman of the Year. Following the season, Edgecombe declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]], forfeiting his remaining collegiate eligibility.{{cite news |last=Longley |first=Sheldon |title='VJ' officially declares for the NBA Draft |url=https://www.thenassauguardian.com/sports/vj-officially-declares-for-the-nba-draft/article_5f814cbf-bcd6-4019-b168-a844979c03ee.html |access-date=December 17, 2025 |work=[[The Nassau Guardian]] |date=April 22, 2025}} ==Professional career== Edgecombe was selected with the third overall pick by the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] in the [[2025 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/45585265 |title=76ers select Baylor's VJ Edgecombe with No. 3 pick|website=ESPN.com|date=June 25, 2025|access-date=June 25, 2025}} In his NBA regular-season debut on October 22, 2025, Edgecombe scored 34 points, pulled down seven rebounds and collected three assists to help the Sixers to a 117–116 win against the [[2025–26 Boston Celtics season|Boston Celtics]].{{Cite web |title=Sixers head coach Nick Nurse praises V.J. Edgecombe’s historic NBA debut |url=https://www.basketballnetwork.net/latest-news/sixers-head-coach-nick-nurse-had-nothing-but-praise-for-vj-edgecombe-sensational-debut |website=Basketball Network}} His 34 points were the most all-time in an NBA debut in Sixers franchise history,{{cite web | last=Murphy | first=Matt | title=VJ Edgecombe Records Historic NBA Debut With 34 Points | website=NBA | date=2025-10-23 | url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/76ers-rookie-vj-edgecombe-delivers-historic-nba-debut | access-date=2025-12-08}} surpassing the previous record of 30 set by [[Allen Iverson]], and the third-most all time in NBA history, trailing only [[Wilt Chamberlain]] (43; 1959) and [[Frank Selvy]] (35; 1954). He also surpassed [[LeBron James]]' previous record (12) for the most points scored in a quarter in an NBA debut, with 14.{{Cite web |last=Heyen |first=Billy |date=2025-10-23 |title=76ers' VJ Edgecombe scored most points in NBA debut since Wilt Chamberlain in 1959 {{!}} Sporting News |url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nba/philadelphia-76ers/news/76ers-vj-edgecombe-scored-most-points-nba-debut-wilt-chamberlain-1959/846d852347981041b65f6c64 |access-date=2025-10-23 |website=www.sportingnews.com |language=en-us}}{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/philadelphia-76ers/76ers-news-vj-edgecombe-nba-debut-turns-heads-history-books|title=76ers rookie VJ Edgecombe’s NBA debut turns heads, enters history books|website=ClutchPoints|last=Capps|first=Kendall|date=October 22, 2025|access-date=October 22, 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/76ers-vj-edgecombe-breaks-records-held-by-lebron-james-allen-iverson-in-incredible-nba-debut-vs-celtics/|title=76ers' VJ Edgecombe breaks records held by LeBron James, Allen Iverson in incredible NBA debut vs. Celtics|website=CBS Sports|last=Salerno|first=Cameron|date=October 22, 2025|access-date=October 22, 2025}} On November 4, Edgecombe recorded his first career [[double-double]], with 12 points and 11 rebounds in a 113–111 loss to the [[2025–26 Chicago Bulls season|Chicago Bulls]].{{Cite web |date=2025-11-05 |title=76ers' VJ Edgecombe: Posts first NBA double-double |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/76ers-vj-edgecombe-posts-first-nba-double-double/ |access-date=2025-11-05 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}} On March 19, 2026, Edgecombe recorded a career-high 38 points, along with 11 assists, in a 139–118 win against the [[2025–26 Sacramento Kings season|Sacramento Kings]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/vj-edgecombe-erupts-for-38-as-the-76ers-beat-the-kings-139-118/|title=VJ Edgecombe erupts for 38 as the 76ers beat the Kings 139-118|website=CBS Sports|date=March 20, 2026|access-date=March 24, 2026}} In Game 2 of the [[2026 NBA playoffs#(2) Boston Celtics vs. (7) Philadelphia 76ers|Eastern Conference First Round]] against the Boston Celtics, Edgecombe recorded 30 points and 10 rebounds in a 111–97 win, becoming the youngest player in NBA history to record a 30-point, 10-rebound game in the postseason, as well as the first rookie to do so since [[Tim Duncan]] in 1998.{{cite web |title=76ers rookie makes playoff history in Game 2 win over Celtics |url=https://nesn.com/boston-celtics/news/76ers-rookie-makes-playoff-history-game-2-win-over-celtics/320117636f43da0617df1b52 |website=NESN |date=April 22, 2026 |access-date=April 28, 2026}} During the playoffs, it was announced that Edgecombe had finished third in [[NBA Rookie of the Year]] voting behind [[Cooper Flagg]] and [[Kon Knueppel]] and had been selected to the [[NBA All-Rookie First Team]].{{cite web |title=Cooper Flagg named 2025-26 Kia NBA Rookie of the Year |url=https://www.nba.com/news/kia-nba-rookie-of-the-year-2025-26 |website=NBA.com |date=April 28, 2026 |access-date=May 21, 2026}}{{cite web |title=Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel headline 2025-26 Kia All-Rookie Teams |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2025-26-all-rookie-teams-announced |website=NBA.com |date=May 21, 2026 |access-date=May 21, 2026}} ==National team career== Edgecombe was named to the [[Bahamas men's national basketball team|Bahamas national team]] for the [[2024 FIBA Men's Olympic Qualifying Tournaments – Valencia|2024 Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Valencia]].{{cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2024/07/02/bahamas-vj-edgecombe-olympic-qualifier-finland/|title=' He has shown serious flashes': VJ Edgecombe dazzles in Bahamas' win over Finland in Olympic qualifier|first=Cody|last=Taylor|website=The Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=July 2, 2024|access-date=July 8, 2024}} Edgecombe averaged 16.5 points, 5.5 rebounds and 3.8 assists in four games, including 12 points, six rebounds and five assists in the final against Spain.{{cite web |title=The Bahamas' Edge: VJ Edgecombe talks about time with the national team |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/news/the-bahamas-edge-vj-edgecombe-talks-about-time-with-the-national-team |website=FIBA |date=August 12, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} He opened the tournament with 20 points in a 96–85 win over Finland—drawing attention from Finnish media as an 18-year-old "surprise card"—and then top-scored with 21 points in a 90–81 victory over Poland, capped by a dagger three in the final minute.{{cite web |title=Bahamas lock in to hold off Finland in opener |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/news/bahamas-lock-in-to-hold-off-finland-in-opener |website=FIBA |date=July 2, 2024 |access-date=October 26, 2025}}{{cite web |title=Susijengille iso pettymys olympiakarsinnassa – Bahaman yllätyskortti oli 18-vuotias Edgecombe |url=https://yle.fi/a/74-20097649 |website=Yle |language=fi |date=July 2, 2024 |access-date=October 26, 2025}}{{cite web |title=Bahamas qualify for Semi-Finals, outlast Poland |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/news/bahamas-qualify-for-semi-finals-outlast-poland |website=FIBA |date=July 3, 2024 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} Although limited by foul trouble in the final against Spain, Edgecombe made several key baskets and helped the Bahamas close the gap late in the game before ultimately falling short.{{cite web |title=86–78: ¡España y Rudy vuelan de Valencia a París! |url=https://www.feb.es/2024/7/7/baloncesto/espana-rudy-vuelan-valencia-paris/98522.aspx |website=Federación Española de Baloncesto |language=es |date=July 7, 2024 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} His teammates praised his poise despite his age. [[Buddy Hield]] said that Edgecombe was "elite and special... so electric, with all the intangibles," while veteran guard [[Eric Gordon]] described him as "one of the most athletic and gifted young players in our game."{{cite web |title=Philadelphia 76ers guard VJ Edgecombe takes torch for Bahamas basketball |url=https://andscape.com/features/philadelphia-76ers-guard-vj-edgecombe-takes-torch-for-bahamas-basketball/ |website=Andscape (ESPN) |date=July 10, 2025 |access-date=October 26, 2025}} Edgecombe later said that playing alongside NBA veterans such as Hield and Gordon "was a true confidence booster."{{cite web |title=The Bahamas’ Edge: VJ Edgecombe talks about time with the national team |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-olympic-qualifying-tournament-2024-valencia-spain/news/the-bahamas-edge-vj-edgecombe-talks-about-time-with-the-national-team |website=FIBA |date=August
